title: Top band of the 1930s: Sidney Desvigne
summary: Desvigne's band was the busiest in the Depression, with William Houston arranging.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: I wouldn't have that kind of a piece of it. Let me turn it off for a second so I can look up some more questions here. Okay. What would you say the top band during the 1930s was around town? Which one got the most work? Depression kids.
Well, uh, Sinted Esbien was top.
He got a lot of work and everything?

Yeah, he was popular. Yeah, he was working. They would, they was playing all those top tunes. Somebody, I think Houston used to do most of the arranging for him at that time. He used to play the piano. Which Houston is that? The one that played the piano, William Houston.

Not Fats, no. Not Fats, William Houston. And everything would come out on the juice box that those people go for. Well, they'd write, put on paper. And it was pretty close on that. And it'd make them at all, practically all in Larry's band. Larry, big band. And I was doing all good, all right myself. Mm-hmm. Long in that number.
